subject: Inconsistent detailing of the sprinkler branch line at Mechanical Room 3B between Fire

messages.text: The sprinkler branch line shown in Fire Alarm Riser Diagram FA-501 at Mechanical Room 3B isn't detailed consistently with Fire Protection Sheet FP-101 -- need direction before we release the sprinkler shop drawings. This is becoming a priority as sprinkler rough-in proceeds toward the fire marshal walkthrough. There may be a cost impact if repiping or additional fittings are required. This could affect the fire marshal walkthrough schedule. There's no hard deadline on this, but a timely response is appreciated.
